Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Registered Office Criteria The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or the Bidder must possess a legally registered and fu lly functional office within the State of Kerala. To validate this, the bidder shall furnish a valid Goo ds and Services Tax (GST) registration certificate explicitly reflecting the registered office address in Kerala. 2. Technical Experience & Track Record

The bidder must possess proven competence and relevant experience in the successful supply, in stallation, and commissioning of the items specified in this bid. The bidder shall attach documentary evidence comprising at least three (3) completion certificate s or work order copies of a similar nature executed via the GeM portal within the State of Kerala d uring the Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. Brand-Specific Proven Performance: The participating bidder/seller must have a documented histo ry of successfully supplying products of the exact same proposed brand during the preceding thre e (3) financial years. Legible and verifiable supporting documents—such as GeM invoices, contract award copies, or client satisfaction certificates—shall be submitted as definitive proof of such bran d-specific compliance. 3. Local Service Support & Infrastructure To ensure prompt after-sales support and minimize equipment downtime, a fully operational auth orized service center must be available within the consignee’s district. The bidder shall submit valid address proof of the designated service center. The service center must house certified and qualified engineers capable of providing comprehensi ve warranty and technical support. 4. Product Lifecycle & Validity The bidder shall propose only current, active, and non-obsolete OEM models. End-of-Life (EOL) or End-of-Support (EOS) products will not be entertained. All offered hardware must carry active OEM warranty support from the date of final acceptance. 5. Completeness of Documentation Bidders are strictly required to compile and upload all requested certificates, undertakings, and su pporting documents specified in the Bid Document, Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), and su bsequent Corrigendums. Failure to upload any required document, or the submission of incomplet e credentials, shall render the bid non-responsive and liable for immediate rejection during technic al evaluation. 6. Quality Certifications To ensure compliance with statutory quality standards, both the participating Bidder and the resp ective product OEM must hold valid ISO certifications. Relevant, unexpired ISO certificates must be attached to the technical bid. 7. OEM Warranty, Support & Service Network The successful bidder must submit a formal OEM Warranty Certificate at the time of equipment de livery. The seller shall guarantee prompt rectification, troubleshooting, or component replacement at no additional cost during the entire stipulated warranty period. The OEM/Seller must possess a well-established, pan-India network for installation, commissioning , training, and after-sales service to assure prompt field support. 8. Self-Certification Mandate The bidder shall upload a formal Self-Certification statement confirming unconditional acceptance of, and strict adherence to, all terms, conditions, and clauses stipulated in this Additional Terms a nd Conditions (ATC) document. 9. Buyer’s Rights and Reserved Authority The Buyer reserves the unilateral right to accept or reject any bid, or annul the entire bidding proc ess, based on technical evaluation, independent market surveys, or the verifiability of the offered product specifications without assigning any reason thereof. 10. Established Platform Experience The bidder must demonstrate structural stability on the Government e-Marketplace by possessing a minimum of seven (7) years of continuous operational experience on the GeM platform. Valid do cumentary proof, such as the portal registration dashboard or initial order profiles, must be enclos

ed. 11. Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) The bidder must either be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an explicitly authorized p artner/dealer of the proposed product line. Bidders representing an OEM must submit a valid, tend er-specific Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) issued directly by the OEM on their official lett erhead, validating authorization for this specific procurement. 12. Comprehensive & All-Inclusive Pricing The financial quotation must be entirely all-inclusive. The bid price shall encompass the base cost of the hardware, logistics, delivery to the consignee site, standard installation, commissioning, and basic configuration charges. No hidden or supplementary costs will be entertained post-award . 13. Strict Technical Compliance The technical specifications outlined in this tender constitute the absolute minimum essential requ irements. Bidders must ensure full compliance with these benchmarks and must append official, u naltered OEM product datasheets for rigorous technical cross-verification. 14. Non-Blacklisting Declaration The bidder must provide a formal self-declaration executed on the company’s official letterhead, s olemnly affirming that the firm has not been blacklisted, suspended, or debarred by the GeM porta l, or any Central/State Government organization, within the preceding five (5) years. 15. GeM Seller Rating Benchmark To ensure high service standards, the participating bidder must maintain a minimum of a 4-star fi nal GeM Seller Rating (LBL). A verifiable screenshot of the seller's rating profile from the GeM dash board must be attached as proof. 16. Business Volume Threshold The bidder must demonstrate strong fiscal capacity and market presence by having achieved a cu mulative business volume of ₹10 Crore or above exclusively on the GeM platform. Supporting vali dation from the GeM dashboard or a verified order summary sheet must be uploaded. 17. Financial Capability & Business Turnover The bidder shall submit Chartered Accountant (CA)-certified financial turnover details explicitly co vering the last three consecutive financial years (FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26) as def initive proof of financial capability, structural stability, and reliable business performance. 18. Onsite Product Demonstration Following the opening of technical bids, the Buyer reserves the right to request a physical, onsite demonstration of the offered product models at the Buyer’s designated office. The bidder shall arr ange the demonstration within the stipulated timeframe at their own expense to verify operational conformity. 19. Preferred Brand & Quality Eligibility To maintain infrastructural standardization, technical reliability, and seamless integration with exi sting institutional IT networks, the buyer prefers established premium market brands. Offered pro ducts should belong to reputed OEMs with a proven global and national enterprise presence, such as HP, Dell, or Acer. To ensure compliance with quality, durability, and standard component align ment, bids proposing unverified or minor assembly brands will be rejected. .
